attempts.summary: Deployed an Ansible playbook from control_node (node3) that: (1) on node2, installs a simulated "inventory" application (systemd service logging via syslog tag "inventory") and configures rsyslog to forward its messages via TCP to node1, with a disk-assisted queue so messages buffer locally if node1/the network is unreachable; (2) on node1, configures rsyslog with an imtcp listener on port 514 (opened in firewalld) that filters on programname "inventory" plus source IP and persists messages to /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Both rsyslog and the inventory app are enabled at boot. Verified live log flow, verified queuing/resync across a deliberate node1 outage, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of node1 and node2, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of services, firewall port, and log flow after each restart.
